title: Sandwich ELISA
summary: Quantitative measurement of a soluble antigen using a capture antibody pair. Industry-standard quantitation for cytokines and serum proteins.

reagents.name: Stop solution (1 M H2SO4 or 2 N HCl)

hazardsMd: Stop solution is concentrated acid — wear gloves, goggles, lab coat. TMB stains skin and clothing.
contentUndergrad:
## Standard curve discipline
Always run an 8-point dilution series + 2 blanks per plate. Fit with a 4-parameter logistic (4PL); a linear fit will mis-quantify high values.

steps.title: Coat plate with capture antibody
steps.instructionMd: Dilute capture antibody to 1-2 μg/mL in coating buffer. Add 100 μL/well to high-binding 96-well plate. Seal, incubate 4 °C overnight.
steps.verificationMd: All wells filled to identical volume. Plate sealed flat (no peel).

steps.title: Block
steps.instructionMd: Wash 3× with PBST. Add 200 μL blocking buffer per well. Incubate 1 hour RT.
steps.verificationMd: Each well has visible meniscus of blocking buffer. No dry wells.

steps.title: Add standards and samples
steps.instructionMd: Wash 3× PBST. Add 100 μL standard (8-point dilution series) + samples in duplicate or triplicate. Seal, incubate 2 hours RT.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Pipette accurately — variation here propagates through the standard curve.
steps.verificationMd: Plate map filed. Standards in clearly marked columns. Replicates pipetted with the same tip change protocol.

steps.title: Detect
steps.instructionMd: Wash 3× PBST. Add detection antibody (100 μL/well), 1 hour RT. Wash 3× PBST. Add streptavidin-HRP, 30 min RT. Wash 3× PBST.
steps.verificationMd: Each step's wash water clear by the third wash.

steps.title: Develop and read
steps.instructionMd: Add 100 μL TMB substrate. Incubate 15-30 min RT in the dark. Add 50 μL stop solution (color shifts blue → yellow). Read at 450 nm within 30 min.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Stop solution is acid; pipette into wells, do not splash.
steps.verificationMd: Color gradient across the standard curve clearly visible. 4PL fit R² > 0.99. Sample CV < 15% across replicates.
